scope: One reused Mars execution, one fresh 44s flat Gazebo/DART execution, 35 paired private model diagnostics. No live controller/observer/predictor edits.
causal_boundary: The I40/I41 200ms dynamic forecast never actuated the live trace. The older 120ms kinematic synchronizer did actuate and is audited separately.

terrain_hypothesis.verdict: Supported association with changing terrain and contact handoff; local-model mismatch also measured. Individual causes not isolated.
terrain_hypothesis.threshold_caveat: Mars10mm threshold already fires at startup1.0s. Time-aligned20mm tracking error starts2.69s, largely lag. 6.86s names the declared20mm local-path event, not the first error of any size.

geometry.qualification: DEM closest tangent and geometric facet at equivalent contact XY are evaluator proxies, not DART force-weighted physical contact normals. Equivalent points can average several contacts.

terrain_hypothesis.counterfactual_limit: Flat removes all relief/rocks/lava and rebalances for flat terrain; initial state/history differ. Reference/time/velocity byte-identical; whole-terrain comparison does not isolate one local slope.

turn_hypothesis.verdict: First Mars turn is delayed reversal without geometric overshoot; later three selected turns have genuine geometric component overshoot. Flat also overshoots.
turn_hypothesis.definition: First six smooth reference velocity-component reversals, full reference speed>=5mm/s; maximum signed component distance beyond reference extremum over [-1,+2]s. Actual new sign must persist>=100ms. Component reversal is not a full-reference stop.
turn_hypothesis.limit: Different initial balancing and previous path/contact histories preclude isolating terrain amplification at every turn. One run per terrain, not statistical robustness.

prediction_hypothesis.verdict: Frozen-local-model mismatch remains even with hindsight actual commands; wrong future feedback sequence alone does not explain the departure-window prediction error.
prediction_hypothesis.mode_A: Native5ms feedback on predicted states; no future actual inputs.
prediction_hypothesis.mode_B: OFFLINE HINDSIGHT MODEL REPLAY using saved FUTURE actual5ms commands; never deployable or actuated.
limits: Event-selected overlapping windows from one Mars trace; not independent experiments or population accuracy.
Both models retain the same frozen observer-fitted plane/friction and reset integration per5ms.
Model B removes divergence in future commands by using hindsight; this does not make it a deployable estimator/controller.
Contact force sampling uses the model last-physics-step convention, before integrated endpoint state; raw labels/loads can chatter.
Conditional patch-point/lever errors omit unmatched or unloaded patches; report their denominators and label errors separately.
Projected lever evaluation uses logged DEM-tangent normal for the actual side, not a DART force-weighted surface normal.
Reduced B error can identify sensitivity to predicted feedback evolution but does not uniquely establish a controller/estimator/model cause.

verification_scope: Saved-data helper/adversarial contract checks; one new Gazebo run; exact source-history and first-step checks for35A+35B; source/input/old-pack hashes. I40selected45tests are earlier overlapping evidence, not a new/full-repo I41suite.
decision: Keep currentLQR. Before controller tuning or PF/iLQR, isolate transient patch/load classification and gain/drive handoff around6.7–6.9s in a separately declared matched diagnostic. Separately investigate flat-turn lag/damping. Dynamic local-plane prediction remains offline; no fix or causal ablation claimed.
